title: Adobe Instagram Filters
summary: A set of interchangeable Instagram filters for Swinburne’s Orientation Week and Adobe partnership events, featuring design elements drawn from Adobe Creative Suite applications.

meta.Software: Spark AR, Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects
meta.Deliverables: Set of interchangeable Instagram AR filters

blocks.label: Overview
blocks.heading: One set, one theme, five apps.
paras: For Swinburne’s Orientation Week event and Adobe’s partnership seminars, I designed interchangeable Instagram filters using Meta’s Spark AR. Each filter draws on UI and creative elements from specific Adobe Creative Suite applications, creating a cohesive theme across the set.
